criteria.requirement: Add feedparser.readers.entry_text(entry,*,prefer=(text/plain,text/html,application/xhtml+xml),languages=(),strip_html=True). Select existing nonempty local content with MIME priority then declared language order/source order, accepting native content lists and legacy JSON single-content dict; normalize text/html/xhtml aliases. Fall back to real summary_detail or summary only when no usable content. Return text plus original value/type/language/source/index, leaving entry unchanged. Optional limited HTML text extraction preserves block/break/entity order and excludes script/style text; do not claim sanitization. Never fetch src, invent a body from title, accept unknown types silently or generate a summary.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
